vulnerability.category_l2: Unbounded recursion: nested START_GROUP wire-type fields inside unknown fields recurse through UnknownFieldSchema.mergeFrom with no depth limit, so a crafted message overflows the Java stack

description: The Java protobuf runtime parses unknown fields through UnknownFieldSchema. At v3.20.1 the WireFormat.WIRETYPE_START_GROUP case of mergeOneFieldFrom (lines 98-105) calls mergeFrom(subFields, reader) at line 101 with no recursion-depth parameter and no limit, and mergeFrom (lines 114-121) loops back into mergeOneFieldFrom. Each nested group therefore adds a Java stack frame proportional to the nesting depth encoded in the wire message. A message whose unknown fields contain deeply nested groups, parsed by the full or lite runtime (including DiscardUnknownFieldsParser paths and map fields), recurses until the thread stack is exhausted and the process throws StackOverflowError. The fix 4728531c on the 3.25 branch adds DEFAULT_RECURSION_LIMIT=100 and a currentDepth parameter: the START_GROUP case increments the depth, throws InvalidProtocolBufferException.recursionLimitExceeded() at the limit (v3.25.5 lines 84-89), and passes the depth into mergeFrom; the same commit also bounds group skipping in the CodedInputStream.ArrayDecoder skipMessage/skipField implementations (the base CodedInputStream declares skipField abstract) and in ArrayDecoders.

critical_operation.description: The START_GROUP branch of mergeOneFieldFrom recursively merges the nested group through mergeFrom without any recursion-depth parameter or limit. Because mergeFrom (lines 114-121) loops back into mergeOneFieldFrom, every nested group in the unknown-field stream adds stack frames; a crafted message with deeply nested groups exhausts the thread stack. The v3.25.5 fix increments currentDepth and throws recursionLimitExceeded() at 100 before recursing (lines 84-89).

entry_point.description: MessageSchema.mergeFromHelper (line 3909) routes unknown fields into unknownFieldSchema.mergeOneFieldFrom; generated message parsers call MessageSchema.mergeFrom (line 3851) on attacker-supplied bytes.

source_crosscheck.notes: CNA, NVD and the GitHub advisory agree on the mechanism (unbounded recursion while parsing nested groups in unknown fields), on the fixed versions (3.25.5, 4.27.5, 4.28.2) and on HIGH severity: NVD's Primary is 7.5 HIGH (CVSS 3.1) and the CNA/NVD Secondary/GHSA scores are 8.7 HIGH (CVSS 4.0). The CWE mappings differ: the CNA lists CWE-400 and CWE-674, GHSA lists CWE-20/CWE-400/CWE-787, and NVD's Primary is CWE-787; all published values are recorded and CWE-674 (uncontrolled recursion) is the closest match to the mechanism. CVE v5 references only cc8b3483, which the reviewer found to be a whitespace/message-only 'Internal change' rather than the recursion fix; the GHSA references all six commits, and the 3.25-branch commit 4728531c is the one verified as an ancestor of v3.25.5. This root cause is distinct from the previously promoted protobuf entry CVE-2022-1941 (a wire-format parsing issue in the C++ runtime).

independent_corrections_accepted: The CodedInputStream group branch cited at 662-666 is in the nested ArrayDecoder implementation (repeated at 1378 and 2146); the base CodedInputStream declares skipField abstract. File, line numbers and the affected-path conclusion were correct, and the evidence wording was corrected.
d6c82fc5 is a single-parent GitHub squash commit for PR #18388, not a merge commit. The non-ancestry relative to v3.25.5 was confirmed (compare status diverged, ahead_by 75, behind_by 1608).

The GHSA 'Proof of Concept' section links only upstream unit tests (LiteTest, CodedInputStreamTest) and credits the Trail of Bits reporter; it does not link a separate reporter-provided reproduction, so grade A stays unavailable.

NVD tags commit cc8b3483 as 'Patch', but it is a whitespace/message-only 'Internal change' (PiperOriginRevId 653615736, the same internal change as the fix parent 850fcce9), not the recursion fix; the real fix is 4728531c.
The CNA record expresses the Java ranges from version 0 with lessThan only; the recorded RC lower bounds (4.0.0-RC1, 4.28.0-RC1) match GHSA-735f-pc8j-v9w8 and NVD CPE.

Field-semantics clarification: evidence_independent means the reviewer's evidence was derived independently of the dossier, not that a third-party reproduction exists. The reviewer re-evaluated it to true and kept grade B.
review.duplicate_check: The reviewer confirmed this is distinct from CVE-2022-1941 (GHSA-8gq9-2x98-w8hf) on public records: CVE-2022-1941 is an out-of-memory denial of service in the protobuf-cpp and protobuf-python runtimes caused by MessageSet wire-format parsing (CWE-1286/CWE-119, CNA 5.7 MEDIUM, fixed in 3.18.3/3.19.5/3.20.2/4.21.6), whereas CVE-2024-7254 is unbounded Java-runtime recursion while parsing nested unknown group/SGROUP tags, yielding StackOverflowError (CWE-400/674; NVD Primary CWE-787; HIGH 7.5/8.7). Different language/runtime, wire construct, failure mode, CWE set and severity.

limitations: Static verification only; no protobuf parser, generated message or test was run and no StackOverflowError was triggered.

The issue is a denial of service that requires the application to parse attacker-controlled protobuf bytes with the Java full or lite runtime; the CVSS vectors assume network reachability with no privileges.

Only the Java runtime location is recorded; the advisory says the Kotlin and JRuby runtimes are affected because they use the Java runtime, and the C++/other language runtimes have separate advisories not covered here.

The fix is recorded from the 3.25 branch commit 4728531c; the main-branch squash commit d6c82fc5 (PR #18388) has the same content but is a single-parent squash, not a merge, and is not an ancestor of v3.25.5, so it is not used as the fix commit.
Published CWE mappings disagree (CNA CWE-400/CWE-674, NVD Primary CWE-787, GHSA CWE-20/CWE-400/CWE-787); all are recorded and none is coerced into a single authoritative id.
The advisory points to unit tests as reproduction details, but no independent third-party reproduction reference is recorded, so grade A is not available.

NVD tags commit cc8b3483 as 'Patch', but the reviewer found it to be a whitespace/message-only 'Internal change' (same PiperOriginRevId family as the fix parent 850fcce9), not the recursion fix; the fix used here is 4728531c, referenced by GHSA/OSV.
The fix date 2024-09-18 is the committer date; the author date of 4728531c is 2024-09-17.
